title: Final s-wave phase shift
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and express the s-wave phase shift as tan(delta_0) = -k r_0.

title: Phase shift for higher waves
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the phase shift in higher partial waves as tan(delta_l) approximately equal to -((kr_0)^(2l+1))/[(2l - 1)!!]^2 (2l + 1).

title: Continuity condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the continuity condition of the wave function at r = r_0 leading to the phase shift equations.

title: Low-energy behavior
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss how the phase shifts for higher partial waves behave as k approaches 0.

title: Physical interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a physical interpretation of why s-waves dominate at low energy compared to higher partial waves.

title: Common errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the phase shift expressions.

title: Units and limits
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include checks on units and limiting cases for completeness.
